answer: We formalize a subgame-perfect slashing matrix and dynamic opportunity-cost bonds, mandating adversaries lock staking collateral in a cryptographic vault to thwart Sybil multiplication. This structure enforces a strict capital barrier where zero-knowledge verifiable delay triggers slashing penalties if actors forge rogue identities, mathematically guaranteeing strictly negative expected payoffs. Ultimately, this collateral destruction converges to a robust Nash equilibrium, proving rational agents prioritize safeguarding liquidated pearl reserves over unprofitable attacks.
